answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is forfeited when independent audits confirm coordinated Sybil behavior, such as many accounts repeatedly endorsing the same claims while hiding common control. Auditors compare interaction patterns and reward evidence, rather than treating a shared opinion alone as proof. A genuine operator can still participate, but an attacker must fund every identity and risk losing those deposits, so scaling a fake swarm becomes costly. Even pigment, jade, and shale accounts must each put real capital at risk.
